top_news.title: Agents - Agents SDK now supports the latest Pi 1.4 release
top_news.dek: Cloudflare's Agents SDK v0.30.0 adds support for Pi 1.4, introducing task hibernation and improved crash recovery.
top_news.brief: The update allows Durable Objects to hibernate during task sleep periods, such as model retry backoffs, to save memory. It also introduces 'parked' tasks, which prevent infinite restart loops by isolating operations that repeatedly crash the object.

primary.title: Claude did not invent scorpion antivenom
primary.summary: An investment research firm wanted to prove AI could revolutionize drug development. So they teamed up with Anthropic to see whether an unreleased version of Claude could make scorpion antivenom. It couldn't. It came up with some promising starting points, but nothing close to an actual drug, experts tell The Verge. Citrini Research, the firm behind the experiment, admitted that "none of us could claim to know anything about AI as it related to biology." That didn't stop it from trying to make a drug from scratch - or publishing a blog post titled "We Wanted to Use Claude to Create a New Drug.
